role: DI seam: #[async_trait] traits only + the option/param types those signatures need. NO impls (they live in hermit-core, Wave 6).
verification_summary: Verified against the ACTUAL hermit-model (crates/hermit-model/src) and hermit-db (crates/hermit-db/src/entities) sources plus the C# interfaces under MediaBrowser.Controller. All 6 option/param types in the port list are confirmed NOT already present in hermit-model or hermit-db -> they must be ported here. The QueryResult<T> generic, BaseItemDto, MediaSourceInfo, SessionInfoDto, UserItemDataDto, SystemInfo, and UserPolicy already exist and MUST be reused. THREE types the design's REUSE list names -- UserDto, AuthenticationResult, PlaybackInfoResponse -- are NOT yet defined anywhere in hermit-model/hermit-db (hermit-model's own inventory PLANNED them for units 3/5 but they are not yet ported). They are wire DTOs and belong in hermit-model, not hermit-traits: FLAGGED below, do not define them here.

hermit_db_entity_paths.note: Entities are NOT re-exported from crate root or entities::mod; reference them through their submodule path (hermit_db::entities::<area>::<Entity>). Each is a #[derive(sqlx::FromRow)] row struct. IMPORTANT: BaseItemEntity.id is a String (hyphenated Guid as stored), NOT a Uuid -- identity ARGS in signatures still use uuid::Uuid per the design rules; only the row struct's own id field is String.

hermit_model_reuse_paths.note: These already exist in hermit-model — reference by these exact paths in DTO-OUT / API-layer signatures; do NOT duplicate.
hermit_model_reuse_paths.SessionMessageType / GeneralCommand / Pl: hermit_model::session::{SessionMessageType, GeneralCommand, PlayRequest, PlaystateRequest, PlaybackProgressInfo, PlaybackStopInfo, MessageCommand}
hermit_model_reuse_paths.ImageType / MediaStreamType enums (used: hermit_model::entities (verify exact submodule — enum ported in foundation-enums unit)

options_to_port.name: ImageProcessingOptions
options_to_port.notes: Replace 'BaseItem Item' with item_id: Uuid + an ItemImageInfo field (design rule). References ImageFormat/ImageOrientation from hermit_model::drawing. Server-internal.

options_to_port.name: DeleteOptions
options_to_port.notes: Used by LibraryManager.DeleteItem. Small bool-flag struct. #[derive(Default)]. Server-internal.

options_to_port.name: ItemImageInfo
options_to_port.fields: path: String, image_type: ImageType (reuse hermit-model), date_modified: DateTime<Utc>, width: i32, height: i32, blur_hash: Option<String>, is_local_file() computed (!path.starts_with("http"))
options_to_port.notes: Small value struct embedded in ImageProcessingOptions. NOTE: distinct from the DB row BaseItemImageInfoEntity — this is the Controller-level value object. It IS effectively serializable in the API; borderline, but the design assigns it to hermit-traits (embedded in server-internal ImageProcessingOptions) — keep here. Test Default/round-trip if it derives Serialize.

options_to_port.name: AuthorizationInfo
options_to_port.fields: user: Option<UserEntity> (design rule: User -> hermit_db::entities::users::UserEntity), user_id() derived from user (Uuid::nil() when None), device_id/device/client/version/token: Option<String>, is_api_key: bool, is_authenticated: bool, has_token() derived
options_to_port.notes: Consumed by AuthorizationContext / AuthService traits (net.rs). Server-internal (holds a live user entity) -> belongs here, NOT hermit-model.

options_reuse_from_model: QueryResult<T> -> hermit_model::querying::QueryResult (do NOT re-declare; the design's reuse note is CORRECT and verified)

notes: Every option type in src/options/ needs a test (Default/builder + serde round-trip where it derives Serialize). BaseItemEntity.id is String (hyphenated Guid); identity args stay Uuid. The three flagged wire DTOs (UserDto, AuthenticationResult, PlaybackInfoResponse) are the only real gaps — they block a small number of trait return types until hermit-model ports them; port those traits' user-facing returns against UserEntity / the entity layer where the design allows, and leave the DTO-returning methods stubbed/blocked-noted for the port stage.
